items.title: Make Agent Negotiation reachable and bind every accepted deal to the canonical contract authority
items.executionEvidence: One reachable accessible modal now submits only through /api/contracts/negotiate; deterministic persona, leverage, rival-interest and bounded ledger data are canonical and save-safe; obsolete /api/agent routes were removed; focused and aggregate authority tests pass.
items.premise: The Agent Negotiation subsystem is simultaneously dead and unsafe to wire as-is. attachContractYearAgents exists but has no importer; the browser listens for data-agent-player-id buttons that no renderer emits; renderAgentModal returns at a nonexistent #agentModalCard; the API summary and UI field names disagree; and /api/agent/offer can report agent status signed without changing the player contract. The real authority is GameSession.negotiateAndSign through /api/contracts/negotiate.
items.constraint: One canonical mutation path only. Personality and leverage must be deterministic/local, source-derived, save-safe, and disclosed. No user-authored fake rival-interest signal and no endpoint may say signed unless the contract changed.
verification: eligible expiring player has a reachable keyboard-accessible agent surface
counter and acceptance flow through /api/contracts/negotiate and acceptance changes contract years/salary
bounded persona/leverage/history survives save round-trip
server and browser adapters preserve exact response parity
no alternate agent endpoint can report signed without canonical contract mutation

L1.recipe: Retire the misleading parallel /api/agent action path; expose deterministic personality/flavor on the selected-player contract preview and submit through /api/contracts/negotiate only; render a reachable Meet Agent affordance for eligible expiring players.

L2.recipe: L1 plus persist bounded opening/counter/accepted/walked history inside the canonical negotiation ledger; render one accessible modal with ask, guaranteed money, leverage reason, counter, and deadline; actual source-derived rival interest—not a user-authored signal button—drives leverage.

L3.recipe: L2 plus agent memory across seasons, deterministic rival-offer escalation, negotiation deadlines, and Decision Archive chapters, with every factor disclosed and no opaque model call.

items.title: Resolve predictions during ordinary week advance, grade the promised margin, and export the receipts the UI claims exist
items.executionEvidence: Dashboard rollover auto-settles the prior week idempotently, grades winner and exact/within-three/within-seven/miss margin truth, tracks mean absolute error, bounds receipts to 48, and exports the same receipt authority.
items.premise: Normal week advance clears the prior schedule cache and moves scheduleWeek before the prediction panel can see the played game, so streaks often update only if the player manually browses backward. scorePrediction stores/displays margin but defines correctness only by winner. game.html also promises League Story prediction receipts while leagueStoryExport contains no prediction field.
items.constraint: Local-only and explicitly non-causal. Resolution must be idempotent, franchise/year scoped, reload-safe, and prove it never mutates league, schedule, standings, or simulation inputs.
verification: submit Week N then advance normally to N+1 and receive one automatic receipt without browsing backward
reload between submission and advance still resolves correctly
duplicate renders/advances never double-count
exact/within-three/within-seven/miss and tie fixtures grade winner and margin separately
League Story output contains truthful aggregate/recent prediction receipts and no false promise remains
deep-frozen engine/schedule inputs remain byte-identical

L1.recipe: Detect year/week transitions, retain or fetch the just-completed week, resolve it idempotently before cache eviction, and announce a bounded automatic receipt.

L2.recipe: L1 plus grade winner and margin as exact/within-three/within-seven/miss, track winner accuracy and mean absolute margin error separately, persist a bounded recent receipt journal, and include its truthful summary in the League Story export promised by the UI.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a season prediction journal in History/Epilogue with best week, worst miss, and a local share card, still explicitly non-causal and franchise-scoped.

items.title: Prevent rotated caller IDs and evidence-tier spoofing from fabricating a live Community Stats cohort
items.executionEvidence: Public mutations require an allowed Origin and a short-lived participant-bound HMAC capability; trusted-address issuance limits prevent one caller minting k=5; evidence is forced to browser-receipt; client retry, withdrawal and adversarial tests pass.
items.premise: Community mutation routes accept requests with no Origin, the public event normalizer lets callers self-label server-runtime evidence, rate limits bind to a caller-chosen participant ID, and aggregation counts each resulting hash toward the k=5 live threshold. Five rotated IDs can therefore manufacture the appearance of a real cohort despite otherwise sound consent, retention, dedupe, and suppression logic.
items.constraint: Keep consent explicit and withdrawal functional. Never collect durable IP addresses. Trust forwarded client IP only from the declared loopback proxy. Capability issuance must be bounded and fail closed without adding a paid dependency or requiring an account.
verification: public ingress always normalizes to browser-receipt and cannot self-promote evidence tier
missing-Origin browser mutations are rejected or explicitly classified
five rotated caller-chosen participant IDs from one issuance authority cannot cross the trusted cohort threshold
short-lived capability binds participant ID, expiry, nonce/use ceiling, ingest, and withdrawal
real browser consent/withdrawal, CORS, batch, dedupe, cache, and k=5 semantics continue to pass

L1.recipe: Force public ingress to browser-receipt, reject or explicitly classify missing-Origin mutations, trust X-Forwarded-For only from loopback proxy, and add rotating-ID plus evidence-escalation adversarial tests.

L2.recipe: L1 plus issue a short-lived server capability bound to participant ID using an ephemeral process signing key, rate-limit issuance by trusted client address without persisting IP, and enforce nonce/use ceilings on ingest and withdrawal so caller ID rotation cannot mint a trusted cohort.

L3.recipe: L2 plus separate guest/browser and Obelisk-verified cohorts with trust-banded public display after the accountless product posture is formally reconciled.

items.category: Speed / organization / browser and agent efficiency
items.title: Recover durable first-decision headroom by islanding every non-Overview tab
items.executionEvidence: Roster, Contracts, Draft and Stats are true lazy islands with intent/focus/idle preload, hydration retry and per-island budgets; the static shell is 610,654/730,000 bytes with 48/58 modules and zero lazy leaks (16.35% byte headroom).
items.premise: The live boot checker reports 723,294/730,000 bytes and 57/58 modules: 99.1% of the byte ceiling and one module slot. History/Settings/exports already prove a centralized island authority, but Roster, Contracts, Draft, and Stats remain statically imported from app.js even though tab hydration only delays data, not code. Their raw module files total about 79.8 KB before dependencies.
evidence: scripts/check-browser-boot-budget.mjs live receipt: 723294/730000 bytes, 57/58 modules, 0 lazy leaks
items.constraint: Preserve one hydration owner, action behavior, all module reachability, static hosting, keyboard navigation, and zero lazy leaks. Do not merely ratchet the budget again.
verification: boot checker reaches at most 650,000 bytes with at least 15% declared headroom
Roster, Contracts, Draft, and Stats load on tab intent and remain reachable
island budgets and no-lazy-leak checks fail closed
focused hydration/action tests and the full Playwright journeys pass
desktop/mobile dark/light rendered pixels show no loading or interaction regression

L1.recipe: Move Contracts and Draft behind two new uiIslands entries, route exports/actions through invokeUiIsland, and add literal-import plus interaction parity tests.

L2.recipe: L1 plus island Roster and Stats so every non-Overview tab loads on intent, enforce per-island byte budgets, and preload only on pointer/focus/idle hints without paying first-decision parse cost.

L3.recipe: L2 plus thin app.js into a declarative action/tab registry with bounded coordinators and a measured before/after parse/boot receipt.

items.title: Restore exact-revision staging-before-production and refresh release truth from live origins
items.executionEvidence: Candidate-side release authority is complete: rebuilt Pages artifact, current release-range 44-capture hash-bound visual receipt, exact-revision deploy/verify scripts, rollback contract, and launchReady false. Exact SHA staging and production proof execute only after the immutable closeout commit.
items.premise: The forked release gate found live staging at dbec766… while production reports 4435c6b… and the current repository is 354a4f6…. verify-staging-receipt is BLOCKED 12/14 on source revision and artifact fingerprint, and stored release evidence is expired at the older c71a260… revision. Production has outrun stable staging, contradicting the declared deployment discipline.
items.constraint: Deploy and verify the final candidate on stable staging first, bind rendered-pixel and artifact receipts to that SHA, then publish directly to main without equating deployment success with launch readiness. Never force-push or fabricate external launch gates.
verification: stable staging health revision equals the final candidate commit
staging artifact fingerprint matches the built candidate and rollback authority is fresh
release-range rendered-pixel receipt covers every touched UI state, theme, desktop, and mobile
after direct-main publication production provenance matches the same SHA/fingerprint
launchReady remains false until email, founder approval, lifecycle, and other independent gates clear

L1.recipe: Deploy the final candidate to stable staging, run exact-SHA/fingerprint/route/rollback verification, and stop before main if any receipt is red.

L2.recipe: L1 plus bind current release-range rendered-pixel evidence and refreshed release truth to the candidate; only after staging is green publish direct to main and prove production provenance without changing launchReady.

L3.recipe: L2 plus harden CI so production publication cannot start unless an unexpired stable-staging receipt names the exact candidate SHA and artifact fingerprint.

items.title: Make the Hall of Fame celebration a real accessible modal with observable share failures
items.executionEvidence: The ceremony uses the shared modal manager with dialog semantics, focus entry/restoration, Escape/backdrop close, observable clipboard/download outcomes and sanitized filenames; rendered review also raised both new modal close targets to 44px.
items.premise: Every neighboring high-value overlay declares dialog semantics, but hofCeremonyOverlay is a plain hidden div. openHallOfFameCeremony toggles hidden and assigns onclick handlers without the shared modal manager, focus restoration, Escape handling, or a clipboard rejection path. The feature has no direct ceremony/modal test despite being a player-facing reward surface.
evidence: test/season-value-authority.test.js covers Hall data but not ceremony interaction
items.constraint: Reuse the shared modal authority, keep canvas/share output source-derived and escaped, and make clipboard/download failure visible without blocking Hall rendering.
verification: overlay has role dialog, aria-modal, stable label, Escape close, focus entry, and focus restoration
close button and backdrop use the same close path
clipboard success and rejection produce explicit observable feedback
download guards missing canvas/context and sanitizes filename
focused fake-DOM interaction tests plus rendered desktop/mobile dark/light ceremony captures pass

L1.recipe: Add dialog semantics, use modalManager for focus/Escape/backdrop, and add one focused interaction test.

L2.recipe: L1 plus observable clipboard/download success and failure behavior, complete fake-DOM interaction coverage, and rendered-pixel receipts in both themes at desktop and mobile.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a reduced-motion-aware induction sequence and accessible live transcript, without changing Hall scoring or inventing achievements.
